result.instructions: Tools for Dropbox Sign, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Dropbox Sign data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run dropbox_sign_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run dropbox_sign_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run dropbox_sign_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. dropbox_sign_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: dropbox_sign_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Get info about the API-key owner's Dropbox Sign account (id, email, quotas, plan). API: GET /account.

tools.name: dropbox_sign_get_team
tools.title: Get team
tools.description: Get the caller's team, including its members and invited members. API: GET /team.

tools.name: dropbox_sign_list_signature_requests
tools.title: List signature requests
tools.description: List signature requests the account can access, newest first. Paginated. API: GET /signature_request/list.

account_id.description: Account id whose requests to list (defaults to the caller).

query.description: Search string to filter requests (e.g. title, signer email).

tools.name: dropbox_sign_get_signature_request
tools.title: Get signature request
tools.description: Get the status and details of a single signature request by id. API: GET /signature_request/{signature_request_id}.

signature_request_id.description: The id of the signature request to retrieve.

tools.name: dropbox_sign_get_signed_files_url
tools.title: Get signed files URL
tools.description: Get a temporary URL to download the signed document(s) for a signature request. API: GET /signature_request/files_as_file_url/{signature_request_id}.

signature_request_id.description: The id of the signature request whose files to fetch.

tools.name: dropbox_sign_list_templates
tools.title: List templates
tools.description: List reusable templates the account can access. Paginated. API: GET /template/list.

account_id.description: Account id whose templates to list (defaults to the caller).

query.description: Search string to filter templates (e.g. title).

tools.name: dropbox_sign_get_template
tools.title: Get template
tools.description: Get a single template's fields, roles, and metadata by id. API: GET /template/{template_id}.

template_id.description: The id of the template to retrieve.

tools.name: dropbox_sign_send_with_template
tools.title: Send signature request from template
tools.description: Sends a signature request built from template(s) to the given signers. When test_mode is true (default) it does NOT send real emails; set test_mode=false to send a REAL, legally-binding signature request. API: POST /signature_request/send_with_template.

template_ids.description: Template id(s) to build the request from.

role.description: Signer role name — must match a role defined on the template.

signers.description: Signers to send to. Each { role, email_address, name }; role must match a template role.

subject.description: Subject line for the signature-request email.

message.description: Message body for the signature-request email.

test_mode.description: Test mode. Default TRUE — no real emails sent. Set false to send a REAL legally-binding request.

tools.name: dropbox_sign_cancel_signature_request
tools.title: Cancel signature request
tools.description: Cancels an incomplete signature request. Destructive — signers can no longer sign. API: POST /signature_request/cancel/{signature_request_id}.

signature_request_id.description: The id of the incomplete signature request to cancel.

tools.name: dropbox_sign_remind_signature_request
tools.title: Remind signature request
tools.description: Sends a reminder email to a signer for a pending signature request. API: POST /signature_request/remind/{signature_request_id}.

signature_request_id.description: The id of the pending signature request.

email_address.description: The email address of the signer to remind.
